mapper.select: select /* com.seinfo.seinfomationA.component.request.mapper.RequestMapper.selectRequestUserInfo */ b.company_nm , b.company_url , a.login_id AS contact_login_id , a.user_nm , a.user_phone , a.user_email from seinfo_vendor_manager a join seinfo_vendor b on a.company_no = b.company_no where a.user_email = #{userEmail} and IFNULL(a.user_pwd_init_yn,'N') != 'Y' and a.bl_yn = 'N'

select /* com.seinfo.seinfomationA.component.request.mapper.RequestMapper.selectUserUid */ user_uid, bl_yn from seinfo_vendor_manager a where a.user_email = #{userEmail} and IFNULL(a.user_pwd_init_yn,'N') != 'Y' and a.bl_yn = 'N'

select /* com.seinfo.seinfomationA.component.request.mapper.RequestMapper.getLastRequestNo */ request_no from seinfo_request WHERE request_no like concat('REQ', date_format(now(), '%y%m'), '%') order by request_no desc limit 1
mapper.insert: INSERT /* com.seinfo.seinfomationA.component.request.mapper.RequestMapper.insertRequest */ INTO seinfo_request ( request_no , user_uid , request_title , request_detail , mfile_group_id , request_state , send_d , reg_dt , reg_user_id , mod_dt , mod_user_id ) VALUES ( #{requestNo} , #{userUid} , LEFT(#{requestTitle}, 100) , #{requestDetail} , #{fileGrpId} , #{requestState} , #{sendD} , now() , #{userEmail} , now() , #{userEmail} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE request_title = LEFT(VALUES(request_title), 100) , request_detail = VALUES(request_detail) , request_state = VALUES(request_state) , mfile_group_id = VALUES(mfile_group_id) , send_d = VALUES(send_d) , mod_dt = VALUES(mod_dt) , mod_user_id = VALUES(mod_user_id)
mapper.select: SELECT /* com.seinfo.seinfomationA.component.request.mapper.RequestMapper.selectRequestHistoryList */ ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY r.request_no ASC) AS rnum , r.request_no , CASE WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(r.request_title) > 30 THEN CONCAT(LEFT(r.request_title, 30), '...') ELSE r.request_title END AS request_title , IFNULL(code.code_nm, '회원등록') AS request_state , CASE WHEN lc.reply_yn = 'N' AND IFNULL(lc_role.user_role, '') = 'ADMIN' THEN '관리자 질문등록' WHEN lc.reply_yn = 'N' AND IFNULL(lc_role.user_role, '') != 'ADMIN' THEN '의뢰자 질문등록' WHEN lc.reply_yn = 'Y' AND IFNULL(lc_role.user_role, '') = 'ADMIN' THEN '관리자 답변등록' WHEN lc.reply_yn = 'Y' AND IFNULL(lc_role.user_role, '') != 'ADMIN' THEN '의뢰자 답변등록' ELSE '' END AS reply_status , CASE WHEN r.send_d IS NULL THEN DATE_FORMAT(r.reg_dt, '%y.%m.%d') WHEN r.send_d IS NOT NULL THEN DATE_FORMAT(r.send_d, '%y.%m.%d') ELSE DATE_FORMAT(r.send_d, '%Y-%m-%d') END AS send_d , vm.login_id AS contact_login_id , CASE WHEN vm.user_role = 'ADMIN' THEN '관리자' ELSE vm.login_id END AS user_nm FROM seinfo_request r LEFT JOIN ( SELECT code_value, code_nm FROM zzz_code_info WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND code_parent_id = 'SE002' ) code ON code.code_value = r.request_state JOIN seinfo_vendor_manager vm ON vm.user_uid = r.user_uid LEFT JOIN ( SELECT request_no, reply_yn, reg_user_id FROM ( SELECT x.request_no, x.reply_yn, x.reg_user_id , ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY x.request_no ORDER BY x.reg_dt DESC, x.request_seq DESC ) AS rn FROM seinfo_request_cont x ) t WHERE t.rn = 1 ) lc ON lc.request_no = r.request_no LEFT JOIN seinfo_vendor_manager lc_role ON lc_role.user_email = lc.reg_user_id WHERE vm.user_email = #{userEmail} AND IFNULL(vm.user_pwd_init_yn, 'N') != 'Y' AND vm.bl_yn = 'N' ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{startRow}

SELECT /* com.seinfo.seinfomationA.component.request.mapper.RequestMapper.getRequestHistoryListCount */ COUNT(*) FROM seinfo_request WHERE user_uid = ( SELECT user_uid FROM seinfo_vendor_manager a WHERE a.user_email = #{userEmail} AND IFNULL(a.user_pwd_init_yn, 'N') != 'Y' AND a.bl_yn = 'N' )

SELECT /* com.seinfo.seinfomationA.component.request.mapper.RequestMapper.selectRequestProcess */ a.request_no , CASE /* 상태별 표시 */ WHEN a.request_state is null then '1' WHEN a.request_state='01' then '2' WHEN a.request_state='10' then '3' WHEN a.request_state='20' then '4' WHEN a.request_state='99' then '5' ELSE '1' END AS progress , DATE_FORMAT(b.reg_dt, '%Y.%m.%d') AS member_register_d /* 회원등록 날짜 */ , DATE_FORMAT(a.send_d, '%Y.%m.%d') AS send_d /* 의뢰서 제출 날짜 */ , DATE_FORMAT(a.request_accept_d, '%Y.%m.%d') AS request_accept_d /* 의뢰서 접수 날짜 */ , DATE_FORMAT(a.request_complete_d, '%Y.%m.%d') AS request_complete_d /* 의뢰 완료 날짜 */ , a.request_state FROM seinfo_request a JOIN seinfo_vendor_manager b ON a.user_uid = b.user_uid WHERE a.user_uid = (SELECT user_uid FROM seinfo_vendor_manager m WHERE m.user_email = #{userEmail} and IFNULL(m.user_pwd_init_yn,'N') != 'Y' and m.bl_yn = 'N') AND a.request_no = #{requestNo}

SELECT /* com.seinfo.seinfomationA.component.request.mapper.RequestMapper.selectRequestDetail */ ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY a.reg_dt ASC, a.request_seq ASC) AS rnum ,a.request_no ,a.request_seq ,a.question_title ,a.question_content ,DATE_FORMAT(a.reg_dt, '%Y-%m-%d') AS reg_dt ,CASE WHEN a.reply_yn='N' AND b.reply_yn = 'Y' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS reply_yn ,CASE WHEN c.user_role = 'ADMIN' THEN '관리자' ELSE c.login_id END AS user_nm , CASE WHEN b.reply_yn = 'Y' THEN 'N' WHEN b.reply_yn IS NULL AND c.user_email != #{userEmail} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS reg_reply_yn FROM seinfo_request_cont a LEFT JOIN seinfo_request_cont b ON b.request_no = a.request_no AND b.request_seq = a.request_seq AND b.reply_yn = 'Y' LEFT JOIN seinfo_vendor_manager c ON a.reg_user_id = c.user_email WHERE a.request_no = #{requestNo} AND a.reply_yn = 'N' ORDER BY 1 DESC

SELECT /* com.seinfo.seinfomationA.component.request.mapper.RequestMapper.selectReply */ a.request_no , a.request_seq , a.question_title , a.question_content , DATE_FORMAT(a.reg_dt, '%Y-%m-%d') AS reg_dt , a.mfile_group_id AS mfile_grp_id , CASE WHEN b.user_role = 'ADMIN' THEN '관리자' ELSE b.login_id END AS user_nm , a.reply_yn , CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM seinfo_request_cont c WHERE c.request_no = a.request_no AND c.reply_yn = 'Y' AND request_seq = a.request_seq ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS has_opposite FROM seinfo_request_cont a JOIN seinfo_vendor_manager b ON a.reg_user_id = b.user_email WHERE a.request_no = #{requestNo} AND a.request_seq = #{requestSeq} AND a.reply_yn = #{replyYn}
SELECT /* com.seinfo.seinfomationA.component.request.mapper.RequestMapper.getNextRequestSeq */ IFNULL(MAX(request_seq), 0) + 1 FROM seinfo_request_cont WHERE request_no = #{requestNo}
